name: nicolasluraschi-dev-checks
description: Dev-only checks for the static site. Nothing here is served or shipped.

scripts.check: npm run check:static && npm run check:html && npm run test:py && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:py: .venv/bin/python -m coverage run -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && .venv/bin/python -m coverage report
